spatial_meaning: Historical regional model/reanalysis context at API-returned positions. Positions are not field observations, district-area averages or asserted native-cell IDs. District views reuse selected regional observations.

T2M.daily_statistic: Mean air temperature at 2 metres over the daily LST interval
T2M.monthly_statistic: Arithmetic mean of valid daily T2M values; primary value only if the expected month is complete
T2M.crop_comparison_requirement: A sourced mean-temperature criterion for the same crop/variety/stage, dates, averaging period and applicable location; no inference from a daily maximum or a climate normal.

T2M_MIN.daily_statistic: Minimum of the hourly 2-metre air temperatures in the daily LST interval
T2M_MIN.monthly_statistic: Mean of daily minimum temperatures, NOT the absolute minimum of the month
T2M_MIN.crop_comparison_requirement: Match a sourced minimum-temperature statistic and exposure duration/stage. Monthly mean-of-minima cannot stand in for a daily cold event or absolute seasonal minimum. Negative Celsius is not a missing marker.

T2M_MAX.daily_statistic: Maximum of the hourly 2-metre air temperatures in the daily LST interval
T2M_MAX.monthly_statistic: Mean of daily maximum temperatures, NOT the absolute maximum of the month
T2M_MAX.crop_comparison_requirement: Match a sourced maximum-temperature statistic and exposure duration/stage. Monthly mean-of-maxima cannot stand in for a daily heat event or absolute seasonal maximum.

PRECTOTCORR.daily_statistic: Daily mean corrected precipitation rate over one LST daily interval
PRECTOTCORR.monthly_statistic: Sum each daily rate times one day exactly once; incomplete primary total is null
PRECTOTCORR.crop_comparison_requirement: Match a sourced rainfall amount/rate definition, accumulation interval, stage dates, missingness policy and location. A total is not onset, a dry spell, available irrigation volume, flooding depth or crop water demand.

comparison_prerequisites: Reviewed crop/variety/stage evidence with statistic, units and applicability explicitly defined
Agreed actual dates and period including cross-year/leap-day handling; printed BAMIS standard weeks are not assumed ISO weeks
Matching accumulation or averaging support and expected/valid day counts; no silent interpolation or partial-as-complete totals
Explicit representative location or district-context mapping, original anchor, returned position and distance
Source/artifact identities and processing version retained with any derived comparison
not_thresholds: Printed BAMIS climate normals describe source calendar context; they are not crop tolerance thresholds, hard exclusions or success labels.
unsupported_policy: Humidity/wind/sunshine require a separately defined need, parameter, acquisition scope and method; do not synthesize them from these four variables.
missingness: Documented -999 source fill becomes null with missing_reason. Keep a real zero; do not clip unusual values. Primary monthly values are null if any expected daily value is missing.
rule_activation: No weights, crop limits, soil facts or success probabilities are defined here. Missing essential applicability evidence remains incomplete/unavailable.
